Unsold stock, depreciation and owner opportunity cost are not accrual net profit. Idle samples do not certify no feasible action.

lastHeartbeat.scope: Runner process memory; host/observer elapsed time, not a device benchmark

workforceSnapshot.definition: Final-tick headcount/capacity, not utilization over the whole run.

fullEconomy.importDefinition: B1 ImportPurchased is a paid external purchase at the terminal; net removed subtracts final pickup stock and may reflect returns. Legacy market imports collected are separate.
fullEconomy.laborSampleDefinition: Headcount-weighted non-ready group samples, deduplicated within tick. Not full observed worker idle time.
fullEconomy.movementDefinition: Actual MovementStarted→MovementArrived event intervals, inclusive activity otherwise unspecified. No distance/speed formula is substituted for elapsed ticks.

roi.reason: Mixed enterprise/road portfolios require attributable revenue and costs. Unobserved payback stays censored; no static-margin extrapolation.
